::: {.callout-warning}
## Status (V542-V543): B0 NOT INFORMATIVE; B ends
- **The question:** do simulated human mergers stop (minimum speed below 1 m/s in the 10 s before the merge) more often than real mergers on NGSIM US-101 and I-80, at matched follower speed?
- **Where it stopped:** at stage A, on counts only; no stop outcome was read.
  - US-101: 69 % of mergers are in view for under 10 s before merging.
  - I-80: 14 % censored.
  - Power stays below 0.5 at both sites.
- **Speeds don't overlap:** field target-lane speeds are low (96 % of I-80 leaders under 10 m/s), while the plant's spread over all bands.
- **Conclusion:** these two NGSIM sites cannot measure stopping before a merge.
- **Consequence:** limit M1 (lane-end standing) is carried in the claim. Option B ends: no B1 rerun and no drone-data request (V543).
:::
